name: Why is my toilet not flushing?

mainEntity.name: Why is my toilet not flushing?

acceptedAnswer.text: A toilet that isn't flushing can be caused by several issues. Common reasons include a low water level in the tank, a faulty flapper that isn't lifting or sealing correctly, a clogged overflow pipe, or a problem with the fill valve. Less common but possible causes involve blockages in the trap or main drain line. Identifying the specific cause usually requires a quick inspection of the toilet's internal components. If you're in Goodyear, Buckeye, Avondale, Surprise, or Waddel, Alpha-Plumbing Services can help diagnose the problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common reasons your toilet isn't flushing include low water in the tank, a faulty flapper, or a clogged overflow pipe. Blockages can also prevent proper flushing.
